first_impression.summary_in_own_words: It's a planner that does weddings in Portugal, palaces in Sintra or cliffs in the Algarve, and you get one advisor from start to finish. The top tells me the legal bit takes a month and lots of people do a symbolic one there and the legal one at home. No idea yet what any of it costs.

attention_map.quote: with one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend
attention_map.why: One person handling it is exactly what I want when we're planning from Australia. The palace and cliff line is pretty. The symbolic-at-home line answers something I'd half wondered.
Three quick taps is fine on my phone, but 'Check your date' then 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms dates and venues with you' means it doesn't actually check anything. Felt like a form in disguise.

attention_map.quote: Planned by Wedded Concierge, with one Wedded Advisor from enquiry to the wedding weekend.
attention_map.why: Same sentence I just read. Nothing that tells me they've done this before.

attention_map.quote: Romantic palaces in the Sintra hills that can be booked for a wedding
attention_map.why: This is the 'something different' bit. A palace you can actually book is not what everyone else is selling. The Monserrate scaffolding note is honest, I liked that.
Five times in a row. Guest count is the first thing I need to know and every card dodges it. Airport codes are useful, but no sizes, no prices, no actual venue names, just regions.

attention_map.quote: state events can cancel bookings at Queluz or the National Palace of Sintra
attention_map.why: Good to know before falling in love with it. Still no idea how many people fit or what it costs.

attention_map.quote: Australian, US and UK passport holders can visit visa-free for up to 90 days
attention_map.why: Fine, our guests can come without visas. The rest repeats what I already read.

attention_map.quote: exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill
attention_map.why: This is the blow-out stuff I'm scared of. Nice that someone checks it, but it also confirms the prices will move around.

attention_map.quote: An overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised.
attention_map.why: Actually useful for us, with Smartraveller linked. But there is a lot of US and UK detail to scroll past on a phone at night.

attention_map.quote: What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things: your guest count, the region, the season, how many nights you take the venue and whether you book it for exclusive use.
attention_map.why: I opened the Costs tab for a number and got 'it depends'. That's the answer every planner gives before they ring you.

attention_map.quote: There is no set Portugal package.
attention_map.why: I like the weekend shape, welcome dinner, ceremony, brunch. But no package and no price means I can't compare it with anything.

attention_map.quote: Many quintas have rooms, so your closest guests can stay where you marry, with nearby hotels for everyone else.
attention_map.why: Answers where our guests stay, roughly. No idea how far the hotels are or how long the drive from the airport is, except 'many Lisbon-area venues are 15 to 30 minutes'.

attention_map.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is your one contact at Wedded Concierge, instead of one conversation per venue.
attention_map.why: The three steps are clear, but who is this person? No name, no face, no 'we've done 40 weddings in Portugal'. It's a job title.

attention_map.quote: Placeholder: Budget, dates you have in mind, anything else
attention_map.why: Form is not too long and I can say 'Not sure yet', which is me. But they want my budget and won't give me theirs.

attention_map.quote: There is no single average: the cost depends on your guest count, the region, the season, the nights you take the venue and whether you book it for exclusive use.
attention_map.why: Second time I've asked how much and been told it depends. The legal and beach answers are good though.

attention_map.quote: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's wedding
attention_map.why: After all that careful legal stuff, celebrity gossip links. Feels like a different website.

questions_answered.question: What does this cost all in, and what is included in the from price?
questions_answered.evidence: No from price anywhere. Costs tab and FAQ 4 both say it 'depends on' guest count, region, season, nights and exclusive use. 'There is no set Portugal package.'

questions_answered.question: Can it fit our guest count?
questions_answered.evidence: Every region card says 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor'. The form has guest bands ('30 to 60', '61 to 100') but nothing on the page says any venue holds that many. 'Elopements and small weddings are welcome' says nothing about 60 or 80 people.

questions_answered.question: Who would actually plan this with us, and what do they do?
questions_answered.evidence: 'one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend', the three 'How It Works' steps and 'check each venue contract for rooms, buy-outs, minimums and VAT'. What they do is clear; who they are is not. No name, no experience in Portugal.

questions_answered.question: How do our guests get there and where do they stay?
questions_answered.evidence: Four airports (LIS, OPO, FAO, FNC), visa-free for Australians up to 90 days, 'Many quintas have rooms... with nearby hotels for everyone else'. Nothing on flights from Australia or transfer times outside Lisbon.

questions_answered.question: Is our budget realistic for this place?
questions_answered.evidence: No figures at all. 'Your Wedded Advisor talks you through the options for your plans.'

objections_triggered.objection: I don't know if my budget is possible for this many people
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things' and 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor'

objections_triggered.objection: Prices look like they start low and will blow out
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill', 'a buy-out is often charged separately from the venue fee', 'fees may be charged either way, with a minimum'. Honest, but with no base number it just lists ways it gets dearer.

objections_triggered.objection: Planning from overseas, time zones and suppliers I can't meet
objections_triggered.triggered_by: Partly eased by 'your one contact at Wedded Concierge, instead of one conversation per venue', but nothing about time zones or how we'd talk from Australia.

objections_triggered.objection: Every planner's page looks the same
objections_triggered.triggered_by: The palace booking rules and Australian passport detail feel different. The 'Ask your Wedded Advisor' on everything and the 'it depends' cost answer feel exactly like every other planner.

trust_signals_noticed: Who my planner is and the steps: steps yes ('Tell us your plans', 'Talk it through', 'Shape your weekend'), the actual person no
Official sources named and linked: Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy in Lisbon, Parques de Sintra
Honest caveats: 'Monserrate's roof works run to early 2027', state events can cancel palace bookings
Airport codes per region, and 'Many Lisbon-area venues are 15 to 30 minutes from the city centre, as a guide'
Missing: a from price with inclusions, named spaces with capacities, real weddings
turn_offs_noticed: No price signal at all: no from price, no ranges, Costs tab gives no number
Guest capacity deflected to 'Ask your Wedded Advisor' on all five region cards
Long scroll on mobile: lots of US and UK passport detail an Australian couple has to get through
Celebrity 'Trending row' (Ronaldo, Perrie Edwards) at the bottom cheapens it

emotional_response.excited_by: Booking a real palace in Sintra, a Douro vineyard weekend, the three-day shape with Sunday brunch
emotional_response.reassured_by: One advisor, the legal steps spelled out for Australians, the contract checks
emotional_response.anxious_about: Money. Nothing on the page tells us whether 30 to 75k for 60 people is in the ballpark
emotional_response.overall: Interested and a bit dreamy, then deflated every time I looked for a number.

payload.decision_reason: The palaces and the one-advisor idea are enough to save it and send to my partner, but none of my three must-haves is there: no from price or inclusions, no venue that says it fits our 60 to 80 guests, and no named person. I'm not filling in a form with our budget when they won't give me a single number back. Honestly this probably dies in my saved tabs unless Portugal is already on our list.
payload.verbatim_reaction: Okay, Sintra palace you can actually hire, that's cool, never thought of Portugal. Screenshotting the Pena bit for him. But how much?? I tapped Costs and it just says it depends on five things. Every single region says 'Ask your Wedded Advisor' for guests. Who even is the Wedded Advisor, do they have a name? The legal stuff for Australians is actually really helpful, and I like that they check the venue contracts for hidden room charges, that's the stuff that scares me. But I can't tell if 60 people is 40k or 140k. Saving it, sending to him, but I'm not giving them our budget until they give me something back. Also why are there Ronaldo wedding links at the bottom, random.

results.check: Read only persona, artefact and persona_review schema (plus envelope schema for format)
Read fallback lines only where APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF pairs appear; s8 treated as not visible
Every top_question assessed with evidence; three of five not answered

assumptions: Read as the launch version: all sign-off-pending lines replaced by their fallbacks, so no cost figures or registry fees visible
Copy stage, so no images judged; captions read as text only
Guest count of 60 to 80 assumed from the persona's typical 31 to 80 band
